summary: Wrap Technologies, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants. The offering comprises 5,771,519 shares at $1.40 per share and pre-funded warrants for 2,800,090 shares at $1.3999 per warrant, exercisable at $0.0001, with gross proceeds of $12.0 million. Maxim Group LLC serves as exclusive placement agent on a best-efforts basis, earning a 7% fee. No minimum offering condition exists. Closing occurred on August 18, 2026. The market price was $1.88 on August 14, 2026. This is a routine capital raise with no special-situation characteristics.
